collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: An elder remembers an old word nobody else knows, and nobody agrees what it means: guess together, or ask the children to use it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) said an old word at dinner: "mohalu". Nobody else has ever heard it. (subject) knows it is a real word: (subject.his/her) grandmother used it. (subject.He/she) just cannot remember what it means. (friend) is fascinated. What should they do with it?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village spends a week guessing. Some say it means a lazy afternoon. Some say a kind of fish. One elder says it was the name of a goat. (subject) is still not sure, but now everyone uses it, for everything.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) and the children start using mohalu to mean the feeling of a warm rock after swimming. Within a month, the whole village uses it that way. (subject) says it might even be right.
